meta.title: EasyClub — the register built for the night
meta.description: EasyClub OS: point of sale and management for your bar, club or restaurant on iPad, with Easy, an AI agent that runs it by voice. Born in Monaco, made for the world.

hero.eyebrow: EasyClub OS · iPad point of sale
hero.lead: Sales, tables, reservations, stock, staff and numbers in one iPad app. And Easy, an AI agent that runs it with you, by voice.
hero.videoLabel: Easy opens table 7, adds two spritz and a negroni, then sends them to the bar.

easy.lead: “Two spritz and a negroni for table 7.” Easy opens the table, adds the order and sends it to the bar when you say so. It works in the app like your team does, on the same screens.

voice.title: By voice or in writing
voice.text: One sentence is enough, even mid-rush. Easy knows your menu and your tables.

rights.title: The rights of whoever is signed in
rights.text: A waiter can’t do what a manager does. Neither can Easy.

confirm.title: Your go-ahead first
confirm.text: Anything sensitive, like closing the register, always waits for a tap on screen.

commands.q: Two spritz and a negroni for table 7
commands.a: Done on T7. Shall I send them to the bar?

commands.q: How much have we made tonight?
commands.a: €3,670.70 incl. VAT over 21 tickets since 11:05. Average ticket: €174.80.

commands.q: Book 4 for tomorrow at 9 pm, name Morel
What are we running low on?
commands.a: 10 items to restock, including brut champagne, sole and Dom Pérignon. Shall I prepare the supplier order?
4 people on shift: Hugo, Inès, Nora and Théo.
Closing the register needs your OK.

tour.title: One app. The whole room.
tour.lead: Everything a service needs, on the iPad already in your hand.

steps.title: The bar in three taps.
steps.text: Big tiles, categories, a crystal-clear ticket. Card, cash or mobile, tips included, receipt by e-mail, text or QR code.

steps.title: A floor plan that’s alive.
steps.text: Dining room, terrace and bar at a glance: covers, rounds sent to the bar or kitchen, split bills.

steps.title: The register, to the cent.
steps.text: The current service, payment methods, VAT, sales per server. Every sale is sealed in a fiscal journal; the Z close takes one tap.

steps.title: Service sets itself up.
steps.text: Tonight’s list, birthdays, the waiting list, and every guest placed on the floor plan as they arrive.

steps.title: Numbers during service.
steps.text: Revenue, average ticket, footfall by hour, menu engineering. Not the next morning: right now.

steps.title: Stock follows sales.
steps.text: Recipes with automatic depletion, stock-out alerts, movement log, supplier orders.

nightday.title: Readable in the dark. And on the terrace.
nightday.lead: Dark by default, to read at arm’s length in a packed room. One gesture in the control centre and the app turns light.

night.title: Made for the room, not the back office.

sync.title: Every iPad, live.
sync.text: Bar, floor and door see the same tables and the same orders the moment they change.

offline.title: Wi-Fi down? Keep going.
offline.text: Sales stay on the iPad and sync as soon as the network is back.

journal.title: A journal that can’t be erased.
journal.text: Every sale is sealed and chained to the one before. Any later change shows.

brand.title: In your colours.
brand.text: Your venue’s name, logo and colour, at launch and on the lock screen.

rights.title: Everyone their rights.
rights.text: Manager, waiter, bartender, host: one code each, and the session locks itself.

native.title: A real iPad app.
native.text: Full screen, always up to date: every improvement arrives without reinstalling.

apps.title: Sixteen apps, one register.
apps.lead: Keep the ones your venue needs, tuck the others away. Tap an app to see it.

monaco.lead: EasyClub was born among the bars, clubs and restaurants that never sleep. A first pilot venue is in service in Monte-Carlo.

cta.title: Let’s talk about your venue.
cta.lead: An iPad demo, at your place, while the room gets ready.
